name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: The angler who landed the Perch's weight is lower than both the angler who landed the Catfish and the angler who landed the Pike.
13 lb goes with exactly one of Gus, Mabel, or Catfish.
If Catfish does not go with Mabel, then Perch goes with 14 lb.
